description:
Put a formation on the field — the manager's main move.

    Bots in both lineups keep their positions. Departing bots: mode "flip"
    closes their positions at market now; "drain" lets them exit on their
    own rules. Arriving bots go through the normal fund rules; any rejected
    are listed in the result. The rationale is published on the fund's
    public manager's log — write it for the fund's followers.
name: switch_formation
